d: Fanatics Momentum is building the UAE's leading regulated commercial gaming operator. Licensed by the General Commercial Gaming Regulatory Authority (GCGRA), we operate across lottery, iGaming, sportsbook, and digital content, combining Momentum's regional foundation with Fanatics' global product, technology, and scale. The business is ambitious, well-resourced, and moving fast. If you want to help build a category-defining operator in one of the world's most exciting regulated gaming markets, this is the right time to join.

The Customer Service Agent will be the first point of contact for our players, providing high-quality assistance and resolving queries related to our online gaming platforms, including account issues, bonuses, deposits/withdrawals, and gameplay inquiries. The role is key in delivering a superior customer experience in line with company values, ensuring players are informed, engaged, and satisfied with their gaming experience.
q: Previous experience in a customer support role, ideally within the iGaming/Lottery, tech.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
Familiarity with online casino/lottery and/or sportsbook platforms and terminology.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn and navigate multiple systems (CRM tools, chat platforms, back-office systems).
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Rotational shift patterns (including weekends and public holidays)

At Fanatics Momentum, we’re proud to be a fair, transparent, and inclusive employer. We value diversity, collaboration, and innovation, and we’re committed to creating an environment where every team member can thrive. If you’re ready to grow your career and help us build Momentum, we’d love to hear from you.
r: Provide real-time support to players via live chat, email, and occasionally by phone in a fast-paced, 24/7 environment.
Handle queries related to registration, account verification (KYC), responsible gaming, transactions, game rules, and promotions.
Guide players through troubleshooting steps for technical issues (login problems, game performance, etc.).
Monitor and escalate suspicious or fraudulent activity according to internal procedures and regulatory guidelines.
Collaborate with internal departments to resolve complex issues.
Stay informed of the latest platform features, games, promotional offers, and industry regulations.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and follow up on open issues to ensure resolution.
Meet performance KPIs such as response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction scores (CSAT).
Contribute to the development of FAQs and knowledge base content.

The company is a new-generation real estate development business based in Dubai. It is creating a portfolio of residential, commercial, and mixed-use developments designed around the future of human living.

It is built on the pillars of thoughtful design, ancient architectural wisdom, intelligent technology, and human-centred data. It is pioneering a new category of real estate: places that actively support human health, wellbeing, and longevity.

Technology is not treated as an add-on. It is integrated into the foundation of every development. The company connects homes, products, and building systems through its proprietary intelligent living system. This intelligence learns from individual needs and evolves over time, creating environments that are more intuitive, responsive, and deeply human.

The Event Coordinator supports the planning, organisation, and delivery of the company’s events, from small gatherings and religious ceremonies to major project and product launches. The role covers broker events, investor previews, exhibitions, groundbreakings, handover celebrations, poojas, festive occasions, and internal company activities across different venues.

Reporting to the Events Manager, the role coordinates the practical details required for successful delivery, including supplier documentation, venue arrangements, guest communications, event assets, schedules, and on-site logistics. It maintains accurate records, follows up on outstanding actions, and ensures that teams and partners receive the information and materials they need on time.

Working with Marketing, Creative, Content, Social Media, Sales, and external suppliers, the Event Coordinator supports a consistent guest experience and timely completion of pre-event and post-event requirements.
q: Degree or diploma in Event Management, Marketing, Hospitality, Business, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience coordinating corporate, property, hospitality, or brand events.
Experience supporting both smaller gatherings and larger launches or productions.
UAE event coordination experience is preferred, with familiarity with local venues and suppliers.
Experience managing guest lists, RSVPs, supplier documentation, schedules, and event logistics.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly spreadsheets and shared trackers.
Familiarity with registration platforms, shared asset libraries, and CRM data handovers is advantageous.
Experience supporting cultural or religious ceremonies is an advantage.
Willingness to travel between venues and work evenings or weekends when required for events.
A valid UAE driving licence is advantageous.
Arabic language skills are an advantage but not essential.
Excellent organisation, attention to detail, and follow-through.
Clear communication with guests, colleagues, venues, and suppliers.
Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and maintain accurate records.
Practical understanding of event setup, logistics, and guest service.
Reliable asset handling and version control.
Ability to remain calm and responsive during live events.
Strong teamwork and willingness to support hands-on delivery.
Sound judgement on when to act independently and when to escalate.
r: Support the Events Manager in preparing plans, schedules, checklists, and task trackers for events of different scales.
Maintain the consolidated events calendar and communicate approved updates to relevant teams.
Record meeting actions, responsibilities, and deadlines, following up on outstanding items.
Coordinate planning meetings, site visits, supplier briefings, and rehearsals.
Maintain organised event folders containing briefs, quotations, approvals, guest records, and operational documents.
Flag missing information, delays, and conflicting requirements to the Events Manager.
Research venue and supplier options against agreed requirements and obtain quotations for review.
Arrange venue inspections and confirm availability, facilities, access arrangements, and setup restrictions.
Collect supplier onboarding documents and follow up with Procurement, Legal, and Finance on required actions.
Support purchase requests, booking confirmations, purchase orders, and invoice processing.
Share approved briefs, schedules, technical specifications, and delivery instructions with appointed suppliers.
Confirm supplier timings, contact details, staffing, equipment, and responsibilities before each event.
Maintain current venue and supplier records, including feedback from previous events.
Prepare and maintain guest lists with Sales, Marketing, leadership offices, and other relationship owners.
Coordinate approved invitations, reminders, confirmations, and practical guest information.
Track RSVPs, attendance changes, dietary requirements, accessibility needs, and VIP arrangements.
Support registration pages, seating plans, name badges, guest packs, and reception materials.
Coordinate transport, parking instructions, directions, and access requirements where needed.
Assist guests professionally and refer sensitive requests or decisions to the Events Manager.
Handle guest information accurately and in line with approved data processes.
Maintain an asset checklist covering invitations, signage, branding, screen content, presentations, films, and other event materials.
Track production and approval deadlines with Creative, Content, and Marketing teams.
Distribute approved files to the correct agencies, venues, and suppliers, maintaining clear version control.
Provide confirmed event details and changes to the Social Media Manager for calendar updates.
Coordinate photography and videography schedules, access, shot lists, and contributor arrangements.
Collect event photography and footage, track approvals, and share final assets with the relevant teams.
Support timely delivery of approved recaps, thank-you communications, and other post-event content.
Assist with arrangements for poojas, festive gatherings, and other cultural or religious occasions under the Events Manager’s direction.
Confirm requirements with appointed priests, officiants, or specialist providers and maintain a checklist of agreed materials.
Coordinate flowers, offerings, ceremonial items, refreshments, seating, and setup as instructed.
Follow up with venues on agreed arrangements for ceremonial activities.
Communicate relevant timings, dietary considerations, and guest guidance clearly and respectfully.
Follow agreed preferences regarding photography, content sharing, and participant privacy.
Coordinate deliveries, supplier access, equipment, event materials, staffing, and hospitality arrangements.
Prepare contact sheets, operational packs, registration lists, and event schedules.
Assist with venue setup and check that branding, seating, guest materials, and hospitality match the approved plan.
Support technical checks and rehearsals, recording issues for resolution by the responsible teams.
Manage assigned on-site responsibilities, including registration, guest guidance, speaker assistance, and supplier liaison.
Communicate issues promptly and follow the Events Manager’s instructions during live delivery.
Support breakdown, stock checks, equipment returns, and venue clearance.
Maintain accurate quotation comparisons, expense trackers, purchase records, and invoice logs.
Flag unapproved charges or cost differences to the Events Manager.
Consolidate attendance records, guest feedback, and relevant enquiries after each event.
Transfer lead information and follow-up requests to Sales and CRM teams through agreed processes.
Follow up on outstanding supplier deliverables, final assets, invoices, and returned equipment.
Archive event records and contribute practical improvements to future checklists and planning.
x: Competitive Tax-Free Salary: Monthly package in AED, commensurate with experience.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
